summary: All 6 targets (30, 36-39, 44) promoted to exact per-episode records with page-level splits, all high confidence. jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com episode pages ('adapted from' field) and the chapter-side reverse map ('anime episode' field) agree page-for-page on every splice; animefillerguide lists the identical chapter sets in the same non-monotonic airing order (ep38: 102, 106, 107, 111, 108, 109; ep44: 126, 133, 127, 128), and hiptoro/sportskeeda/bamsmackpow corroborate at range/event level (Projection Sorcery — ch 111 p.12-13 content — debuts in ep 38; the trio flashback — ch 133 p.1-3 — opens ep 44's post-cold-open). Non-monotonic continue points are recorded honestly: ep 36 resumes at 100 (its p.17-21 airs only in ep 37) and ep 37 resumes at 102 (only p.2-4 aired; ep 38 opens at 102 p.5). One repair: ep 29's stored end 78 understates — fandom + animefillerguide both show ep 29 adapting ch 79 p.2-8, so end=79 (mid) under this batch's END convention; flagged as convention-sensitive since the overhang is only 7 pages.

repairs.why: Fandom episode page lists ep 29 'adapted from' = 76 (p.6-19), 77, 78, 79 (p.2-8), and the ch 79 page's reverse map confirms 'Episode 29 (p.2-8)'; animefillerguide also lists 76-79 for ep 29. Under this batch's END convention (last chapter the episode adapts, partials included — same convention that gives ep 30 end=80 at p.13), ep 29's end is 79 mid-chapter, with continue=79. Stored 78 understates by the 7-page overhang.

flags_for_sean: ep 29 repair (end 78 -> 79) is convention-sensitive: the overhang into 79 is only p.2-8 (7 pages), and the stored manual 78 with implicit continue=79 lands the reader in the same place. Applied for consistency with the batch-15 END definition (ep 30 gets end=80 at p.13 under the same rule) — veto if the stored majority-style END was deliberate.

ep 36/37 boundary: hiptoro's coarse list says ep 12 (our 36) = 98-100 and ep 13 (our 37) = 101-105; fandom (both directions) and animefillerguide agree on the page-split truth (ep 36 ends at 101 p.13; ep 37 re-covers 100 p.17-21 and 101 p.9-19). Coarse sources round splits — the page-level values are the ones recorded.
ch 101 p.9-13 appears in BOTH ep 36 and ep 37 per fandom (perspective retelling of Yuji entering Shibuya Station) — chapters_adapted keeps both honestly; not an error.
